content: Written 2026-10-07 23:55. Real row 4 = S3 + layer defaults (centre evidence, closed-state background) + DM (--depth-median) + O1 (ownerless elements are background to the layer), code a51f005, one code path, staged: A -> eval -> gate A >= 92.71 -> B -> eval -> gate B >= 93.11 -> C (+ GaME's end-of-run refinement) -> eval (C target 94.83). Gates = the user's relaxed targets relayed by the supervisor 23:3x (original minus 0.5). If A fails: the same chain without DM (S3 + layer defaults + O1) from A through C without gates, a full table for the user (supervisor's order (d)). --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --depth-median --dataset real, GAME_CONFIG=flat.yaml.

DM: the export reads the median (2DGS, Huang et al. SIGGRAPH 2024, Eq. 19: the largest depth with T > 0.5, here the centre depth of the Gaussian at which T first drops below 0.5); GaME (arXiv 2506.06909) fits the unnormalised D = sum z alpha T. GaME's D term is kept as published (it supervises alpha); the added term |z_median - d| moves the centre of the Gaussian the readout selects (index from the forward pass, piecewise constant; z = p_view.z as forward.cu computes 'depths[idx] = p_view.z'). Only 2DGS's median definition is sourced; using it as a training term next to GaME's is our design. O1: Khronos keeps geometry integrated before an object's track existed in the background TSDF; closed_object_background.cpp judges background vertices near a closed state by measured absence. An element no object state owns (T1 state membership empty) is background to the layer.
No new constant: the median term has weight 1 as GaME's depth term, visibility = alpha >= GaME's min_opacity (0.3, GaME config), the median threshold T < 0.5 is 2DGS's.
eval_row.sh unchanged; G1 = official median export; old-site residue read with analysis/scripts/old_site_elements.py (strict count: > 10 cm from every current surface) after B.
real_row4dm/{checkpoint_a.pt, checkpoint_b.pt, checkpoint.pt, session_*/}, eval_real; fallback real_row4o1/.

(a) M, E, U on the S3cb B map's B keyframes (analysis/meu_s3cb_b.json, GT-free): M > d + 5 cm on 7.87 % of pixels, E 7.77 %, D 2.16 %; on those pixels E also > 5 cm deep in 76.5 %, E within 2 cm of d (two-layer case) 3.8 %; mean terms M-E 1.11, E-D 4.61, D-d 3.47 cm; |M-E| > 5 cm on 2.0 % of all pixels. (b) unit: z recomputed = rasterizer gs_depth[median_index] = median image, max 3.8e-6 scaled units (analysis/dm_check.json). (c) gradient: autograd vs central differences with the index fixed, float64, max rel. err. 0.056 %. (d) discontinuity: a 0.1 mm step of a top-gradient Gaussian changes the median Gaussian on median 11 (max 89) pixels of a keyframe; the re-selecting difference / autograd ratio q10/50/90 -0.41/0.95/3.36 -- the term is piecewise; the optimiser may move a selected Gaussian so that another becomes the median (read in the smoke: no alpha or count drift). (e) smoke B (S3cb B map, 20 B keyframes, 300 iterations; rules written before): deeper 4.21 % vs control 5.48 %, nearer 0.87 vs 0.93 %, alpha<0.9 0.12 vs 0.13 %, Gaussians 1,585,842 vs 1,585,575: pass. Smoke A (v7 A map, 20 A keyframes; supervisor's rules: nearer <= control + 1 pp, deeper lower, alpha<0.9 <= 3x control): deeper 8.97 vs 10.91 %, nearer 1.68 vs 1.69 %, alpha<0.9 0.35 vs 0.38 %: pass (analysis/dm_smoke/). (f) O1 on the S3cb B map: exactly the 852 alive ownerless object-labelled elements become background, the 424,924 owned object elements unchanged.

A ~15 min, B ~25 min, C ~40 min (+ refinement), evals ~5 min each, DM adds one forward probe per iteration; the synthetic row 4 B (29d7f6e) is stopped for it (superseded by this code) and reruns with the final code afterwards.

Gates A >= 92.71, B >= 93.11, C report vs 94.83. Upper bound (supervisor's export intervention on S3cb B, B views): fixing all deeper pixels gives 93.43-93.46, so B's gain from DM is bounded by ~+1.0 over 92.42. Old-site strict residue after B should not exceed S3cb's 401.

(a) In A the nearer error costs G1 (supervisor's A intervention: replacing nearer >= 5 cm pixels by the reading: v7 A 93.31 -> 94.56); DM acts on the selected Gaussian in both directions. (b) The piecewise median: a selected Gaussian may be pulled to d while the surface behind it is unchanged (a floater in front of a deeper layer would be pulled onto d -- correct; a front Gaussian of a thick surface pulled deeper would expose the layer behind), watched through the deeper/nearer shares of the A eval.

A gate STOP: real_row4dm A P/R/F1 95.14 / 90.15 / 92.58 < 92.71 (v7 95.94 / 90.83 / 93.31; independent A runs of the default form 93.18-93.37; DN 92.53). GT-free A-map readout (analysis/a_map_check_dm.json, A keyframes): median > 5 cm deeper 6.70 % (v7 10.39 %), nearer 7.05 % (v7 5.33 %; 0.5-1.5 m 6.9 %, 1.5-2.5 m 8.2 %), alpha < 0.9 0.26 % (v7 0.26 %), Gaussians 1.80 M (v7 1.74 M). DM trained from the first frame lowers the deeper share but raises the nearer share at near and mid range, as DN did; the smokes (refinement of a trained map) did not show it. The queue fell back to the same code without DM (real_row4o1, S3 + layer defaults + O1) A -> B -> C without gates. No further DM mechanism (no escalation).
